content.short: Bitnob is an African financial app for Bitcoin, stablecoins, payouts, virtual dollar cards and payment APIs.
content.description: Bitnob, founded in 2020 and headquartered in Nigeria, is a crypto-powered financial app for consumers, businesses and developers across Africa. It combines Bitcoin, the Lightning Network and stablecoins such as USDT and USDC with local currency rails to handle cross-border payments, remittances, savings, payouts and virtual dollar cards. Through its consumer app and business API, Bitnob offers multi-currency wallets, wallet infrastructure and on and off ramps so companies can move money globally and settle in local currency. It moves stablecoins across networks including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Polygon and Solana alongside Bitcoin.
content.meta: Bitnob offers Bitcoin and stablecoin wallets, payouts, virtual cards and APIs across Africa. Discover Bitnob and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
